Code AUG appeared 3 times on Evergreen CNYTN-USHOU with ONE HUMEN 101E, CONTI CORTESIA 014E and MOL CREATION 103E, and would have fired a NEW SERVICE alert. It is not new: the same ships and voyage numbers appear on ONE as EC4, ONE HUMEN 101E and CONTI CORTESIA 014E. AUG is Evergreen's name for the Premier Alliance Asia to US Gulf string. Added to the registry under Premier Alliance and aliased EC4 equals AUG. No alert warranted.

Codes JCH with n 1 and NSB with n 4 surfaced on Evergreen KRPUS-USNYC and would have fired an XL candidate and a NEW SERVICE alert respectively. Both are false positives: every row carries a southbound S voyage suffix, UNI-POPULAR 0386-515S, EVER VERT 2094-022S, EVER VISTA 2095-015S, EVER VERVE 2096-015S, EVER VERSE 2097-018S, with 43 to 50 day transits. They are intra-Asia feeder first legs of transshipment routings, which the XL definition excludes. Both added to ignoredCodes.
